WITH female_clients AS (
  SELECT client_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'
),
oldest_female_clients AS (
  SELECT client_id FROM (
    SELECT client_id, birth_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY birth_date ASC) as rn
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT T1.client_id, MIN(T3.A11) as lowest_avg_salary, MAX(T3.A11) as highest_avg_salary, (MAX(T3.A11) - MIN(T3.A11)) as gap
FROM oldest_female_clients AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.A11
GROUP BY T1.client_id	----- bird -----	financial

WITH youngest_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client)
), highest_salary_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    GROUP BY district_id
    ORDER BY A11 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT youngest_clients.client_id
FROM youngest_clients
JOIN highest_salary_districts ON youngest_clients.district_id = highest_salary_districts.district_id	----- bird -----	financial
